## Type of Change

- [ ] `feat`: New feature or user-facing enhancement
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix
- [ ] `theme`: Added or updated curated Invision Community theme
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation update
- [ ] `refactor`: Internal code refactoring with no behavior change
- [ ] `chore`: Build script, dependencies, or CI changes

## Tested Environments

Please mark all browsers and IPS versions on which this change was tested:

- [ ] Chrome / Chromium (tested in `dist/chrome`)
- [ ] Firefox (tested in `dist/firefox`)
- [ ] Invision Community 4.x
- [ ] Invision Community 5.x / Invision Cloud

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the project's coding conventions and formatting.
- [ ] I ran `npm test` and all validation checks passed.
- [ ] I ran `npm run build` to confirm both Chrome and Firefox build cleanly.
- [ ] If applicable, I added or updated relevant documentation.
- [ ] My commits use Conventional Commits (e.g. `feat:`, `fix:`, `theme:`).
